summary: Verified the WordPress-compatible embedded AI chatbot fix end-to-end. The floating FAB now renders from a bare <script data-unitech-chat data-slug='uni2mkt' data-lang='es' async> tag on /embed-test.html with NO wrapper div in the DOM (confirmed div[data-unitech-chat]=false, script[data-unitech-chat]=true). Opening the FAB shows the Spanish greeting; typing 'Hola, necesito un corte de cesped' and pressing Enter triggers POST /api/public/card/uni2mkt/chat (HTTP 200) and a relevant Spanish bot reply is rendered in the panel ('¡Hola! Con gusto te ayudamos con el corte de césped. ¿En qué ciudad estás (Houston, Katy o Sugar Land)? ...'). The 'Ups, no pude responder' error was NOT seen. Backwards-compat code path for [data-unitech-form] and [data-unitech-chat] divs is preserved in init() (lines 432-449 of embed.js).
critical_code_review_comments: embed.js init() correctly checks SCRIPT.hasAttribute('data-unitech-chat') and startChat() guards with chatStarted flag so re-execution of the script (e.g. pasted twice in a CMS) won't double-mount the FAB. No issues found.

User's reported production failure ('Ups, no pude responder') is NOT reproducible on the preview environment — this strongly suggests the issue is specific to the user's WordPress site (likely CORS, mixed-content https→http blocking, or a security plugin stripping the request). Recommend asking user for browser DevTools Network tab screenshot of the failed /api/public/card/uni2mkt/chat call on their WP site.

rca of the issue:
Root cause (already fixed by main agent): WordPress (and many CMS sanitizers) strip empty
tags that have only data-* attributes, so the legacy snippet `
` lost its mount node on WP and the widget silently did nothing. Fix: embed.js init() additionally reads data-unitech-chat / data-slug / data-lang / data-accent from `document.currentScript` (stored in module-level SCRIPT var) and calls startChat() directly; startChat() uses a `chatStarted` boolean to prevent double mounting. Verified live on https://unitech-preview-3.preview.emergentagent.com/embed-test.html — FAB renders, panel opens, bot replies in Spanish via /api/public/card/uni2mkt/chat (200).
